name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: The side panel of an app shell: a provider with the open state and a Ctrl/Cmd+B toggle, a size.panel.xs panel on either side that collapses to an icon rail (labels become tooltips) or hides, a header, a scrolling content area, a footer, labelled groups, menus of buttons or links, a toggle and the main area beside it.
usage: Use Sidebar for the persistent side panel of an application: DBee's connections and schema tree, a settings navigation. Compose it as SidebarProvider (open, onOpenChange; hotkey "b" for Ctrl/Cmd+B) > Sidebar (side, collapsible: "icon" or "offcanvas") with SidebarHeader, SidebarContent (SidebarGroup > SidebarGroupLabel + SidebarMenu > SidebarMenuItem > SidebarMenuButton with icon, active, tooltip; or a Tree), SidebarFooter; then SidebarInset for the main area with a SidebarTrigger. Name the Sidebar with aria-label. For a temporary panel over the page use Sheet; for top navigation, NavigationMenu; resizing the panel is wave 3's Resizable.

props.name: open
props.description: SidebarProvider: controlled open state; defaultOpen (true) when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: SidebarProvider: called when the trigger or the hotkey toggles it.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: SidebarProvider: Ctrl+key (Cmd on macOS) toggles the sidebar; false turns it off.

props.name: side
props.description: Sidebar: the side of the shell.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Sidebar: collapsed, leave an icon rail, hide the panel, or never collapse.

props.name: icon
props.description: SidebarMenuButton: the leading icon, the only thing shown in the icon rail.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: SidebarMenuButton: the tooltip in the icon rail; defaults to a text label.

props.name: render
props.description: SidebarMenuButton: a link instead of a <button>.

props.name: className
props.description: On each part: extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The panel: a complementary landmark, color.bg.surface, size.panel.xs wide, size.control.lg in the icon rail, hidden off-canvas; data-slot="sidebar", data-state, data-collapsed, data-side.

parts.name: SidebarProvider
parts.description: The shell row holding the open state and the hotkey.

parts.name: SidebarContent
parts.description: The scrolling middle of the panel.

parts.name: SidebarGroup
parts.description: A section, role="group" named by its label.

parts.name: SidebarGroupLabel
parts.description: A section heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle; visually hidden in the icon rail.

parts.name: SidebarMenuButton
parts.description: An entry's button or link (size.control.md): icon and label, aria-current when active; in the icon rail a square with a Tooltip.

parts.name: SidebarTrigger
parts.description: An IconButton that toggles the sidebar, with aria-expanded and aria-controls.

parts.name: SidebarInset
parts.description: The main area beside the sidebar, a <main>.

states.name: collapsed
states.description: collapsible="icon" and closed: an icon rail of size.control.lg; labels visually hidden and shown as tooltips.

states.name: offcanvas
states.description: collapsible="offcanvas" and closed: the panel is hidden.

states.name: hover
states.description: An entry under the pointer: color.interactive.hover.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on an entry: the focus ring inside it.

states.name: disabled
states.description: An entry that cannot be used: color.fg.disabled, aria-disabled.

accessibility: The panel is an <aside> landmark named by aria-label; the main area is a <main>; sections are role="group" named by their labels; entries are buttons or links in a list, the current one with aria-current="page".
SidebarTrigger is an IconButton named "Toggle sidebar" with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the panel; Ctrl+B (Cmd+B on macOS) toggles it too (aria-keyshortcuts).
In the icon rail the labels stay in the accessibility tree (visually hidden) and show as tooltips on hover and focus, so entries keep their names.
An off-canvas sidebar that is closed is display:none, so its content leaves the tab order.
The width change transitions over motion.duration.base; prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns it off.
